Reports whether this instance should receive traffic. Returns 200 `{"status":"ready"}` only while serving AND Postgres answers a ping AND a Kafka broker answers a metadata request (ADR-0038; topics are never required and the verdict is cached for 3 s). Returns 503 `{"status":"not_ready"}` once graceful shutdown has begun (ADR-0022): readiness is flipped first so a Kubernetes readinessProbe stops routing new requests during the drain window, while the liveness probe (`/healthz`) stays green. Returns 503 problem+json (`dependency-unavailable`) naming `postgres` and/or `kafka` while a dependency is unreachable.
